page.overview:
Who is Heavy Duty?

Heavy Duty was the call-sign of Hershel Dalton, who served as G.I. Joe's Heavy Weapons Specialist.

Heavy Duty is seen along with the rest of the Joes stopping the Baroness and her Neo-Vipers from stealing a case of nanomite warheads from Duke, Ripcord and a team of Rangers. Using a minigun, he stops several Cobra forces, before engaging in a stand-off with Duke, who believes he and his men are also trying to steal the case.

Heavy Duty later trains Duke and Ripcord in usage of the Delta-6 Accelerator Suits. When Sgt. Stone appears and asks if Duke and Ripcord are Joes, he calls them "jokes." He watches Duke train with Snake Eyes and is disappointed when Duke actually lands a blow on him, having been rooting for him to fail.

During the attack on the Pit, Heavy Duty is seen wielding a machine gun and a grenade launcher, which he uses to destroy the Cobra's drilling vehicle and shoving a grenade in a Neo-Viper's helmet. He later drives the Joes to their target in a white van where he briefs them on their objectives and explains to Ripcord how expensive the suits are only to have him fall on it.
